note: Bitterroot NF (Sula Ranger District) campground in a wooded area by Warm Springs Creek, a tributary of the East Fork of the Bitterroot River (cutthroat fishing rated fair): from Sula 2.9 mi NW on US 93, then about 1.5 mi west on Medicine Springs Road #370. Elev ~4560 ft. --Claude
